purpose: Freeze a local-only tokenizer, chat wrapper, and whole-node prefix-packing rule for the RPM-style inference-only transfer without authorizing model calls or claiming an exact RPM reproduction.

packing.output_reserve_basis: The public Qwen model card recommends 32768 output tokens for most queries; this is a frozen transfer choice, not evidence of the private RPM serving configuration.
packing.input_order: The immutable RPM decision-time context v1 order: journal step descending, then node SHA-256 ascending.
packing.unit: one complete canonical serialized context node
packing.selection: largest prefix before the first node whose inclusion makes either AB or BA exceed the prompt token limit
